messages:
maria: quick pass on the playground streaming UI. three small issues: stop/pause meaning, token counter prominence, prompt library peek hides stream. figma: https://figma.com/file/stream-ux-mini
sam: Which two do we ship for beta?
maria: 1) Clarify stop vs pause with short labels + tooltip details. 2) Reduce token counter visual weight while streaming (default low-density).
alex: Dev note: Stop currently hard-cancels; Pause resumes. I can split actions + add undo toast ("Generation stopped — Undo" 5s) instead of modal. Will debounce token updates to 1s to avoid jank.
aria: Accessibility: streaming container should be aria-live="polite"; token counter must NOT be its own live region. Toast should receive focus and announce with screen readers; Undo must be keyboard focusable.
maria: Copy suggestion: keep labels short: "Stop" (tooltip "Stops and discards current output"), "Pause" (tooltip "Pause output; resume later"). We'll A/B explicit variants later.
sam: Default inline counter under prompt; add a settings toggle for a floating token pill for power users. Track toggle usage.
alex: Implement split-pane for prompt library on desktop, overlay on mobile. I'll add toggle + debounce + toast.
deploy-bot: branch playground/stream-clarity created, basic copy + aria changes. CI green.
maria: I'll update Figma with toast states and tooltip copy. Assign: @alex impl toggles+undo+debounce, @aria a11y test plan, @sam metrics spec.
sam: I'll wire analytics events and dashboard slices. ETA next week.
aria: I'll run axe + NVDA tests once the branch is up.
maria: Thanks 94 small scope, big clarity wins. :sparkles:
